{{Top|leg}}
'''Merisee Agra''' was one of the three primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. It was a cargo port where [[toz]] [[Grain/Legends|grain]], [[Utozz]], and pharmaceuticals were transported in bulk.
